description_en: Queries the list of sandboxes for a managed agent in a specified workspace. You can filter results by sandbox ID and active session ID fragments
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中托管智能体的 Sandbox 列表，支持按 Sandbox ID 和当前有效 Session ID 的片段组合筛选
name: ListSandboxes

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive fuzzy search by sandbox ID fragment
parameters.help_zh: 按 Sandbox ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: search_text

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive fuzzy search by active session ID fragment
parameters.help_zh: 按当前有效 Session ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for querying the next page. When paginating, keep workspaceId, agentId, searchText, sessionId, and maxResults unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标；翻页时须保持 workspaceId、agentId、searchText、sessionId 和 maxResults 不变
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value SUCCESS is returned if the request was successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request was successful

items.description_en: The list of sandboxes that match the filter conditions
items.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的 Sandbox 列表

activeSessionCount.description_en: The number of active sessions for this sandbox
activeSessionCount.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 当前的活动 Session 数量

createdAt.description_en: The time when the sandbox was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: Sandbox 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastActiveAt.description_en: The time of the last activity on the sandbox, in RFC 3339 UTC format
lastActiveAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次活动时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastHeartbeatAt.description_en: The time of the last heartbeat from the sandbox, in RFC 3339 UTC format
lastHeartbeatAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次心跳时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

maxConcurrentSessions.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed for this sandbox, derived from the auto scaling configuration in effect at runtime. This value is empty if auto scaling is not enabled or the configuration is unavailable
maxConcurrentSessions.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 允许的最大并发 Session 数，取自运行时生效的自动扩缩容配置；自动扩缩容未启用或配置不可用时为空

phase.description_en: The current running phase of the sandbox

sandboxId.description_en: The sandbox ID. You can call the ListSandboxes operation to query sandbox IDs
sandboxId.description_zh: Sandbox ID，可通过 ListSandboxes 查询

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value success is returned if the request was successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌；为空表示没有更多结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合本次查询条件的记录总数
